runs.u: Name a villain.
runs.reply:
One iconic villain is **Doctor Doom** (Victor Von Doom) from Marvel Comics.

He is the arch-nemesis of Marvel's Fantastic Four and a rival to Spider-Man. Known for his immense intellect, mastery of sorcery, and a hidden, unyielding sense of honor and nobility underneath his megalomania, Doom rules the fictional nation of Latveria. He wears his silver and gold helmet to hide a scar he received as a child, which he believes caused the death of his mother. His complexity makes him one of the most formidable and enduring antagonists in comic book history.

As the Grand Vizier of Agrabah, he is a cunning and ambitious sorcerer who seeks the Power of the Genie to become a genie himself and rule the world. He is known for his slick mustache, iconic hookah breathing, and his ability to transform into a powerful snake or a giant tiger.

runs.u: Name a villain.
